items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Zentralen Bußgeldbehörde Beispielsaarland.
items.computation: This is a formally served notice (Zustellungsurkunde, §182 ZPO), so the deemed-delivery rule for ordinary post does not apply; the delivery date is the date written on the returned Zustellungsurkunde: 'zugestellt am 21.11.2026' (a Saturday). The two-week Einspruch period runs from that actual delivery date. Counting starts the day after delivery (§187 Abs.1 BGB): 22.11.2026. Two weeks later (§188 Abs.1 BGB) falls on Saturday 05.12.2026. Since the last day is a Saturday, the deadline shifts to the next business day (§31 Abs.3 VwVfG / §43 StPO) — Monday 07.12.2026, no intervening Saarland holiday.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (once the notice becomes final)
items.quote: Zahlen Sie erst, wenn dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, und dann binnen zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE94 5901 0000 0006 6121 00.
items.computation: Payment is only due once the Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final), which happens if no Einspruch is filed by the end of the two-week objection period computed above, i.e. the notice becomes final on 07.12.2026 (end of day) if unchallenged. The further two-week payment period then starts the day after (§187 Abs.1 BGB): 08.12.2026, and ends two weeks later (§188 Abs.1 BGB) on Monday 21.12.2026, a business day, so no shift is needed. This date only applies if no Einspruch is lodged; if an Einspruch is filed, the notice is not final and no payment is yet due.

warnings: The payment deadline (21.12.2026) only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026; filing an objection suspends the payment obligation until the matter is resolved.

Before paying, confirm the recipient account name matches the Zentrale Bußgeldbehörde via the bank's mandatory payee-name check (Empfängerüberprüfung), even though the printed IBAN is a valid German account matching the letterhead.
